verifiedSemantics: Positive values below 1500000000000 are recording-start offsets; negative values are recording-end offsets; values at or above the threshold are absolute epoch milliseconds.
Calendar strings without a timezone use the converter JVM's default timezone.
Time-only input also uses the conversion-day date rather than recording day.
An appended Z and timestamp duration suffix 10s are unsupported by the v4.5 timestamp parser.
Filter boundaries are inclusive; adjacent windows can count a boundary event twice.
